rows.grounds: fused form given; relates to ebhiḥ with yuktena (sandhi noted, not split)
fused verb form; vidyājapana + ācaret (sandhi noted, not split); mantra japa of vidyā

items.question: What prescribed practice is enjoined for the practitioner after the stated elements are joined, addressed to the Goddess?
premises: stated joined elements are specified in prior instruction
the address is directed to the Goddess as recipient of the injunction
the enjoined act is performance of vidyā japa
items.inference: With those joined elements, the practitioner should perform vidyā japa, addressed to the Goddess.
uncertainties: exact internal sandhi boundaries inside fused tokens not expanded in rows
items.plain_english: O Goddess of gods, with these joined, one should perform the japa of the vidyā.
